VR Environment — Team Project

Return to the Opera

A 10-week XR stage production combining real-time Unreal Engine environments with live performance and filming.

Overview

Where Live Performance Meets Real-Time 3D

Return to the Opera was a 10-week collaborative XR production built in Unreal Engine. The project merged live performance with real-time virtual environments, creating an immersive stage experience that blended physical and digital worlds. The environments were designed to evoke the grandeur of a classic opera house while supporting live action filming within the scene.
